Metadata.title: Viktória & Tomi's Wedding
Metadata.description: We cordially invite you to our wedding!

Venue.title: The Wedding Venue
Venue.subtitle: We are delighted to welcome you to the Etyeki Czímeres Estate!
Venue.directions: Plan your route with Google Maps

Rsvp.title: RSVP
Rsvp.description: If it turns out you cannot celebrate with us, we will of course understand and accept it with all our hearts - we just ask you to let us know in advance, so a beautifully set place at the table doesn't wait in vain.
Rsvp.successAttending: We look forward to celebrating with you!
Rsvp.successNotAttending: We're sorry you can't celebrate with us.
Rsvp.transferInfoDesc: For the comfort of our guests — so everyone can enjoy the evening to the fullest without any worries — we provide a transfer service upon request. The bus departs from and returns to Székesfehérvár. The price is 5,000 HUF/person, which includes the cost of the round-trip.
Rsvp.transferInfoCta: Please let us know your transfer request in advance by checking the box below 😊

Info.title: Useful Information
Info.subtitle: To make your preparation and travel as comfortable as possible.
Info.deadlineWarningTextPre: The rooms are only held for us for a limited time! Please indicate your booking intention no later than
Info.deadlineWarningTextPost: , after which the option will be canceled.
Info.villaDesc: Villa Chardonnay Etyek awaits its guests with comfortable rooms. Unfortunately, breakfast is not available, but guests can use the fully equipped shared kitchen for self-catering.
Info.villaF3: Baby cot / Child under 6: free of charge
Info.flamingoShortDesc: Rooms for 2 and 3 people, dining and wellness.
Info.flamingoDesc: Flamingó Borház offers standard rooms with dynamic pricing. Cooking is not possible at the guesthouse (glasses are available). Wine, coffee, and soft drinks can be ordered from the menu. A service fee of 650 HUF/bottle is charged for brought-in alcoholic beverages.
Info.flamingoF4: Wellness use: Free every day until 22:00
Info.flamingoF6: Dinner: Village platter for 2 people 15.000 HUF
Info.flamingoF8: On-site payment: Cash, Credit Card, SZÉP Card
Info.transferDesc: For the convenience of our guests - so you can fully enjoy the evening - we offer the option of a transfer service, the fee for which depends on the number of seats booked.
Info.transferRsvp: Please indicate your request for this in the RSVP section to make the organization smoother for us.

DressCode.title: Dress Code
DressCode.subtitle: We ask you to elevate the evening with your attire, using soft pastel colors.
DressCode.ladiesDesc: If you choose a dress: an elegant maxi or midi dress
DressCode.gentsDesc: Smart casual attire: blazer, shirt, elegant trousers - a tie is not required

Gallery.title: Gallery
Gallery.subtitle: A few of our dear memories together.

Contact.title: Send us a message!
Contact.subtitle: If you have any questions, or just want to send a kind message, you can do so here.

Footer.title: We can't wait to see you!
Footer.subtitle: Thank you for celebrating with us on this wonderful day.

Booking.title: Accommodation Booking
Booking.subtitle: Please choose from the available rooms below. To finalize your booking, a bank transfer is required.
Booking.babyBed: Baby cot / Child under 6: free of charge
Booking.mealsVilla: Unfortunately, breakfast is not available, but guests can use the fully equipped shared kitchen for self-catering.
Booking.checkinFlamingo: Check-in: from 14:00 (Early arrival 1.000 HUF/person/hour, by prior arrangement)
Booking.checkoutFlamingo: Check-out: until 10:00 (Late departure 1.000 HUF/hour, max. 14:00, by prior arrangement)
Booking.wellnessFlamingo: Wellness access (sauna, jacuzzi) is free every day until 22:00
Booking.restaurantNote: They do not have a permanent restaurant, meals are prepared by prior arrangement.
Booking.successDesc: Thank you! Your booking is now 'Pending'. Once we verify the transfer, we will finalize the booking and send you an email (if provided).
Booking.howManyNights: How many nights are you staying?
Booking.priceNoteFlamingo: The price includes the room, tourist tax, and requested meals. Any extra consumption on-site (drinks, massage) is payable at the guesthouse. Cooking is not possible at the guesthouse. A service fee of 650 HUF/bottle is charged for brought-in alcoholic beverages.
